title: The Last Protocol Revisited
author: Silas Halloran
blurb: Isandro Eriksen, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
